part.text:
The robot is resting about 0.8 m in front of the green panel, which marks the end of the corridor.

The route wasn't a straight run. The first walk ended at a plain gray wall, with the green panel visible only off to the side. I turned left, moved along, then turned again to face the panel and walked up to it. The robot is in the "Crouch" posture with motors off.
